name: AppointmentFilter and AppointmentRepo list query (start-before condition)
name: DashboardPage (Awaiting outcome tile and link)

findings.suggested_fix: Show an 'Awaiting outcome / started before now' chip, with a clear action, when started=true. Or drop started when status changes away from SCHEDULED.
findings.text: AppointmentsPage forwards started from the URL, but the filter form never shows it. set() keeps it when the status changes, so after leaving the Awaiting outcome link a user can pick 'Any status' and still get a list cut off at now without knowing.

rubric_items.reason: All changed components (CO-1..4, CO-6..8, CO-10, CO-11) are present in the product code. The counts and filters use the server clock and strict < as designed. CO-5 and CO-9 are left unchanged, as the design says.

SQL stays in repositories and rules in services. started goes through Fields.oneOf, so a bad value is a 400 field error, and the condition uses the existing bound-parameter add() helper. The web link uses the query helper.
8 files changed, each mapped to a design component. There are no unrelated edits and no migration, and no sensitive path is touched.

Invalid started values are a 400 'must be one of true', and the bound is the server clock. One small gap: on the list page the started filter is kept but never shown, so it stays on unseen when the user changes status.

The summary and the per-file changes match the code I read. That includes the $3 parameter shared with upcoming, awaitingOutcome: 0 at 09:20, the awaitingOutcome: 5 fixture, and that the web test has no tile-count assertion.
